Intro: Hello again, my rival. I'll have you know, I have improved my craft, and I am confident that I can now surpass you in quality!
My new fifty third dish, the Rat King's Pie, will definitely surpass you! If only I could advertise this new addition to the city, but…I am lacking in funds.
Unfortunately, only my loyal customers would be able to experience this delight until I can expand my operations. Networking is hard for a ratcatcher.
I'm just here now to give you the bad news before I study how you won the heart of the Svetka. I have a chef's gift, but not a businessman's.
Success: Damn it…the competition will be tough, but I will come out victorious!
Fail: Did you get worse, or are you just scared of the Rat King's Pie. I want a proper rival!
Reject: You rotten rival. You think having the Svetka handle your competition makes you a good chef? One day, justice will come, and you will see those shackles yourself!
